limits: Synthetic complete JSON proves native SDK delivery/error handling, not actual GLM answer quality.
Padding adds leading/trailing JSON whitespace and network overhead, preserving native answer fields.
Early HTTP200 errors are represented as an error object; original error status/body are separately captured.
Production-only durable wire receipt capture has passing offline checks and identical padding/deadline function ASTs.
Original long-delivery failures remain recorded; uncertain model requests are not replayed.
